comment: Ratchet for cross-platform chord parity. Each number is the MAXIMUM number of fixture cases allowed to diverge from the web reference on that channel. Tests fail when a number is exceeded (a regression) and tell you to lower it when the actual count drops (progress). Generated expectations come from web via `npm run parity:export`; hooktheory_parity.json additionally carries Hooktheory's own scraped ground truth. Lower these, never raise them without a written reason.

corpus_parity.note: Synthetic sweep of the chord-object space. Divergences here are shared by iOS and Android and are dominated by chord shapes Hooktheory never emits; see hooktheory_parity for the numbers that describe real songs.

hooktheory_parity.note: Chord shapes that actually occur across 197 scraped Hooktheory songs. This is the number that matters. Remaining divergences need web's chordPolicy.js / borrowedVoicingRules.js policy layer ported to both mobile clients.
